name: youtube
description: Let your agent search YouTube, look at videos and channels, manage playlists, read or post comments, read analytics and reach for every channel you connect, upload a video, change a posted video's title or thumbnail, and get a finished film ready to upload.

ai.insodimension.dimension.title: YouTube
examples: Search YouTube for the three most-viewed talks about Rust async and summarize each
Pull the stats and description for this video id and tell me its like-to-view ratio

setup.title: Reuse (or create) your Google Cloud OAuth client
setup.detail: If you set up Google Drive or Google Calendar you already have one — the same Desktop-app OAuth client works here. If not, create a free Google Cloud project and a Desktop-app OAuth client (no billing, no redirect URI to register).

setup.title: Enable the YouTube Data API v3
setup.detail: APIs & Services → Library → "YouTube Data API v3" → Enable. Creating the client is NOT enough — without this step the connection succeeds but every YouTube call fails.

setup.title: Enable the YouTube Analytics API and the YouTube Reporting API
setup.detail: Same Library page: enable "YouTube Analytics API" and "YouTube Reporting API". They give your agent watch time, retention, traffic sources, thumbnail impressions and click-through rate for each channel you connect. Already connected before? Reconnect so the plugin can ask for analytics access.

setup.title: Publish the OAuth consent screen (In production)
setup.detail: Google Auth Platform → Audience → Publish app. A client left in "Testing" gets refresh tokens that expire after 7 days, so the connection silently dies every week. For your own account, publishing needs no Google review; you may see an "unverified app" warning at sign-in, which is expected for your own client.

setup.title: Copy the Client ID and Client Secret into the form below
setup.detail: Same values as your Drive or Calendar connector — they stay on this machine.

form.label: OAuth Client ID
form.help: Reuse the SAME OAuth client you created for Google Drive/Calendar — no new Cloud project needed; just also enable the YouTube Data API v3. If you don't have one yet, follow the steps above.

form.label: OAuth Client Secret
form.help: The same Client Secret as your Drive/Calendar connector. Google issues one for Desktop app clients even though it isn't treated as secret for installed apps (RFC 8252). Copy it from the same credential page.

failures.title: YouTube API quota exhausted for today
failures.detail: Your Google Cloud project has used today's YouTube Data API quota: 10,000 units shared by most calls, and since 2026-06-01 a separate 100 calls a day for search. It resets at midnight Pacific; a larger quota needs YouTube's compliance audit.

failures.match: has not been used in project|is disabled|SERVICE_DISABLED|accessNotConfigured
failures.title: Enable the YouTube Data API v3
failures.detail: Your account connected, but the Google Cloud project has the YouTube Data API turned off. Enable it, wait a minute, then connect again.

failures.title: Reconnect your Google account
failures.detail: The stored token is no longer valid — run Connect again to re-authorize. If this happens every week, the OAuth consent screen is still in Testing: publish it (Audience → Publish app).

tools.name: youtube_search
tools.description: Search YouTube for videos, channels, or playlists by keyword, by relevance, date or views, optionally only recent ones. Search has its own quota of 100 calls a day.

tools.name: youtube_get_videos
tools.description: Read 1 to 50 videos in one call — title, channel, duration, privacy, synthetic-media flag, and public views, likes and comments.

tools.name: youtube_list_playlists
tools.description: List a connected channel's own playlists — id, title, item count, and privacy status.

tools.name: youtube_list_playlist_items
tools.description: List the videos inside a playlist — position, video id, title, channel and publish date. A channel's uploads playlist shows how often it posts.

tools.name: youtube_playlist_add
tools.description: Add a video to one of a connected channel's playlists. Mutating — confirm the playlist and video first.

tools.name: youtube_list_comments
tools.description: Read the top-level comment threads on a video (plain text, most-relevant first) — comment id, author, like count, and reply count.

tools.name: youtube_post_comment
tools.description: Post a public comment or reply as your channel. Asks you every time; at most 5 a day, and never the same text twice.

tools.name: youtube_get_captions
tools.description: List the caption tracks on a video. Caption text downloads only for videos you own; for others, use the watch pack.

tools.name: youtube_channel_stats
tools.description: Read a channel's public statistics by @handle or channel id, or every channel you connected: subscribers, views, video count, and its uploads playlist.

tools.name: youtube_channels
tools.description: List the YouTube channels you connected. Each Connect adds the channel you pick; Disconnect removes them all.

tools.name: youtube_forget_channel
tools.description: Remove one connected channel's sign-in from this machine.

tools.name: youtube_reach_report
tools.description: Thumbnail impressions and click-through rate for your connected channels' videos, by video or by traffic source, from YouTube's daily reach reports.

tools.name: youtube_video_analytics
tools.description: One of your videos in YouTube Analytics: views, engaged views, watch time, average view duration and percentage, traffic sources and the retention curve.

tools.name: youtube_update_video
tools.description: Change a posted video's title or thumbnail, one change per call. Your session's permission mode decides whether it asks.
